article_sites_published_outcome.name: article_sites_published_outcome
article_sites_published_outcome.value: "article_sites"."state" <> 'published' OR ("article_sites"."published_url" IS NOT NULL AND "article_sites"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_exactly_one_owner.name: media_exactly_one_owner
media_exactly_one_owner.value: num_nonnulls("media"."article_id", "media"."site_id") + CASE WHEN "media"."organization_asset" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1

media_owner_prefix.name: media_owner_prefix
media_owner_prefix.value:
(
    ("media"."article_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."object_key" LIKE ('articles/' || "media"."article_id"::text || '/%'))
    OR ("media"."site_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."object_key" LIKE ('sites/' || "media"."site_id"::text || '/%'))
    OR ("media"."organization_asset" AND "media"."object_key" LIKE 'assets/%')
  )

permissions_scope_organization_check.name: permissions_scope_organization_check
permissions_scope_organization_check.value:
(
    ("permissions"."scope" = 'platform' AND "permissions"."organization_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("permissions"."scope" = 'organization' AND "permissions"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)
  )

webhook_replay_claims_bounded_identity.name: webhook_replay_claims_bounded_identity
webhook_replay_claims_bounded_identity.value: length("webhook_replay_claims"."source") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length("webhook_replay_claims"."replay_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
